original_snippet:
if actor.role != "admin":
        raise PermissionDeniedError(f"User {actor.id} is not an admin")
description: Remove the admin-role guard from remove_member
expected_violation: A non-admin user removes an organization member instead of being rejected
violation_scenario: remove_member(User(id='u2', role='member'), Org(id='o1', members=['u2','u3']), 'u3') removes 'u3' and raises nothing.
rationale: Deleting the two guard lines is the smallest plausible change that lets a non-admin remove a member.
